text: Indeed, the religion that Allah has chosen for His creation and sent His messengers with, and He does not accept any other, is Islam, which is submission to Allah alone in obedience and surrender to Him in worship, and following the messengers in what Allah sent them with at every time until they were concluded by Muhammad, peace be upon him, after whose mission Allah does not accept from anyone any religion other than Islam, which he was sent with. And the disagreement among the People of the Book, the Jews and Christians, did not occur, causing them to split into sects and parties, except after the proof was established against them by sending the messengers and revealing the books; out of transgression and envy, seeking worldly gain. And whoever denies Allah's revealed verses and His signs indicating His lordship and divinity, then indeed Allah is swift in reckoning, and He will recompense them for what they used to do.
